title: 藏经阁残简 第十六章 重归下层库房藏珍藏经阁残简 第九章 底蕴骤增同阶无敌
slug: 残简道藏我靠修复古籍证道
content_zh:
一夜时光转瞬而过。
天边泛起鱼肚白，晨雾漫过青云仙宗的山峦，微凉的山风顺着阁楼木窗钻进来，吹散屋内整夜积攒的墨香。
沈砚缓缓收功，桌上昨夜从废书坪取回的数卷残简已经全部修复完毕，其中记载的吐纳法门与草木丹方尽数烙印神魂。
道基本就圆满无瑕，经过一夜上古道韵持续滋养，丹田灵气凝实到极致，凝气七层巅峰的根基稳如磐石，距离突破凝气八层只差一层薄薄的壁垒。
他将修复完成的书卷细心收进随身布袋，再将桌面收拾干净，抹去所有有人在此修行的痕迹，重新摆出一副整夜埋头清扫书卷的模样。
不多时，楼下阶梯传来熟悉的脚步声，刘松如约而至。
管事依旧一身灰袍，面色带着惯有的不耐，踏入阁楼后随意扫了一圈，见屋内规整有序，没有半点疏漏，心中的挑剔少了几分。
“罚期已满，跟我回下层值守。”刘松淡淡开口，目光在沈砚身上短暂停留，依旧看不出半分异常，周身气息孱弱平淡，和往日那个毫无修为的杂役别无二致。
沈砚垂首应声：“是，管事。”
他跟在刘松身后，缓步走下顶层阶梯，重回阔别三日的下层藏书阁。
下层楼阁烟火气更浓，不少负责整理普通典籍的杂役已经起身劳作，见到刘松路过，纷纷躬身行礼，目光落到沈砚身上时，夹杂着轻视与看热闹的意味。
所有人都记得，沈砚因和外门弟子冲突，被管事罚去顶层清扫废卷，在他们眼中，这是实打实的羞辱。
几道细碎的嘲讽低语悄然飘入沈砚耳中，他却恍若未闻，眼底不起半点波澜。
换做从前，听到这般言语心底难免压抑，如今《破妄文章》运转，一眼便能看穿这些杂役心底浅薄的恶意，不值得他耗费心神动怒。
刘松将他带到下层西侧的一处值守台，冷声道：“往后你便守在此处，打理周边书架典籍，每日早晚清扫，不得偷懒。后院废简今日会全部运去焚书台，此事与你无关，不用再插手。”
特意叮嘱一句，显然还记着前日的冲突，担心沈砚再和外门弟子产生纠葛。
“弟子明白。”沈砚平静应答。
刘松见他顺从，没再多做叮嘱，转身前往别处巡查。
待到管事身影走远，周遭杂役的目光也渐渐收回，沈砚才抬眼打量起周遭环境。
下层藏书阁西侧区域，摆放的大多是寻常入门道书，价值平平，真正的机缘藏在西侧深处常年上锁的储物库房。

那库房堆积着数十年来淘汰下来的破损典籍，宗门嫌修复耗费资源，干脆直接封存，长年累月无人踏足，恰好成了一处无人过问的文脉宝库。
库房门锁只是普通铜锁，以他如今凝气七层巅峰的力量，随手便能拧断，只是眼下不宜动作太大，引人怀疑。
沈砚心中默默盘算，先安心值守半日，等到午后所有杂役外出搬运书卷，藏书阁人手稀疏之时，再悄悄潜入库房搜罗残简。
他走到值守台旁，拿起抹布装作擦拭书架，指尖轻轻抚过一册普通道书，心底无比平静。
重回下层看似回到了往日压抑的生活，实则局势早已截然不同。
昔日他无修为、无道基，只能任人欺辱；如今道基圆满，手握上古绝学，眼底可勘虚妄，整座西藏书阁的残简古籍，尽皆可为他所用。
不多时，几名外门弟子扛着木车穿过藏书阁大门，径直往后院废书坪走去，正是要搬运昨日堆放的废简前往焚书台。
沈砚余光瞥过，心中毫无波澜。
昨夜已经将其中有价值的残卷尽数收走，剩下的空朽竹简尽数留给他们焚烧，不会再损失半分文脉机缘。
正午时分，烈日高悬，藏书阁内大半杂役都领了差事外出晾晒典籍，楼阁之内变得空旷安静。
机会已然到来。
沈砚左右环顾一圈，确认四下无人，脚步轻缓地朝着深处的封存库房走去。
库房大门铜锁锈蚀，他抬手遮掩动作，指尖一缕细微灵气悄然送出，轻轻一拧。
咔嚓一声轻响，铜锁应声断裂，悄无声息。
沈砚推门走入库房，厚重的灰尘扑面而来，一排排堆满破损古籍的木架映入眼帘，无数被宗门抛弃的残简静静躺在暗处，散发出淡淡的文道微光。
看着眼前满库遗珍，沈砚唇角浮起一抹浅淡笑意。
重返下层的第一份机缘，已然摆在眼前。

content_en:
One night passed in an instant.
The sky turned white, morning mist spread over the mountains of Qingyun Xianzong, and the cool mountain breeze came in through the wooden windows of the attic, blowing away the ink fragrance that had accumulated in the house all night.
Shen Yan slowly finished his work. The several scrolls on the table that he had retrieved from the Waste Book Ping last night had all been restored, and all the Tuna techniques and herbs and elixirs recorded in them were imprinted on the soul.
The Tao is basically perfect and flawless. After a night of continuous nourishment by the ancient Taoist charm, the spiritual energy in the Dantian is condensed to the extreme. The foundation of the peak of the seventh level of Qi Condensation is as stable as a rock, and there is only one thin barrier left to break through the eighth level of Qi Condensation.
He carefully put the restored scrolls into his pocket, then cleaned the table, erasing all traces of anyone practicing here, and pretended to have spent the whole night cleaning the scrolls.
Not long after, familiar footsteps came from the stairs downstairs, and Liu Song arrived as promised.
The steward was still wearing a gray robe, with the usual impatience on his face. After stepping into the attic, he scanned around casually. Seeing that the room was neat and orderly, with no omissions at all, he felt less picky in his heart.
"The penalty period has expired, follow me back to the lower level for duty." Liu Song said calmly, his eyes briefly resting on Shen Yan, but he still couldn't see anything unusual. The aura around him was weak and flat, no different from the handyman with no cultivation in the past.
Shen Yan lowered his head and responded: "Yes, steward."
He followed Liu Song, walked slowly down the top stairs, and returned to the lower library where he had been away for three days.
The smoke and fire in the pavilion on the lower floor was even thicker, and many of the handymen responsible for sorting out ordinary classics had already gotten up to work. When they saw Liu Song passing by, they all bowed and saluted. When their eyes fell on Shen Yan, there was a mixture of contempt and fun.
Everyone remembers that Shen Yan was punished by the steward to go to the top floor to clean up waste papers due to a conflict with an outer disciple. In their eyes, this was a real humiliation.
A few small sarcastic whispers quietly floated into Shen Yan's ears, but he seemed not to hear them, and there was no wave in his eyes.
In the past, hearing such words would have made him feel depressed. Now that the "Political Article" is running, he can see through the shallow malice in the hearts of these handymen at a glance. It is not worth his effort to get angry.
Liu Song took him to a duty station on the west side of the lower floor and said coldly: "From now on, you will stay here and take care of the surrounding bookshelves and classics. Clean them every morning and evening. Don't be lazy. All the scraps in the backyard will be transported to the book burning table today. This matter has nothing to do with you, so there is no need to interfere anymore."
A special warning, obviously still remembering the conflict the day before, and worried that Shen Yan would get into trouble with the outer disciples again.
"Disciple understands." Shen Yan responded calmly.
Seeing that he obeyed, Liu Song didn't give any more instructions and turned around to inspect elsewhere.
When the steward walked away and the servants around him gradually withdrew their eyes, Shen Yan raised his eyes to take stock of his surroundings.
In the west area of ​​the lower library, most of the ordinary introductory Taoist books are displayed, which are of average value. The real opportunity is hidden deep in the storage warehouse on the west side that is locked all year round.
The warehouse was piled with damaged classics that had been eliminated for decades. The sect felt that repairing them would consume resources, so they simply sealed them up and left them untouched for many years. It happened to be a treasure house of cultural heritage that no one cared about.
The warehouse door lock is just an ordinary copper lock. With his current strength at the peak of the seventh level of Qi Condensation, he can easily break it, but it is not appropriate to move too much right now to arouse suspicion.
Shen Yan silently calculated in his mind that he would stay on duty for half a day and wait until the afternoon when all the handymen went out to carry books and the library was sparsely manned, then he would quietly sneak into the warehouse to collect the scraps.
He walked to the watch desk, picked up a rag and pretended to wipe the bookshelf, and gently touched an ordinary Taoist book with his fingertips, feeling extremely calm in his heart.
Returning to the lower class seems to be a return to the depressing life of the past, but in fact the situation is completely different.
In the past, he had no cultivation or Dao foundation, so he could only let others bully him; now, he has perfect Dao foundation, holds ancient secrets in his hands, can detect falsehoods with his eyes, and all the fragments of ancient books in the entire Tibetan library can be used by him.
Not long after, several outer disciples carried wooden carts through the library hall.He opened the door and walked straight to the waste book pile in the backyard. He was going to carry the waste slips piled up yesterday to the book burning table.
Shen Yan glanced at it from the corner of his eye, feeling completely unmoved.
Last night, all the valuable scraps were collected, and all the remaining empty and rotten bamboo slips were left for them to burn, so that they would not lose any more cultural opportunities.
At noon, with the scorching sun high in the sky, most of the servants in the library took their errands and went out to dry the classics, making the pavilion feel empty and quiet.
The opportunity has arrived.
Shen Yan looked around to make sure there was no one around, and walked slowly towards the deep storage warehouse.
The copper lock of the warehouse door was rusty. He raised his hand to cover his movements. A subtle spiritual energy quietly came out from his fingertips and he twisted it gently.
There was a soft click, and the copper lock broke silently.
Shen Yan pushed the door open and walked into the warehouse. Thick dust hit his face. Rows of wooden shelves filled with damaged ancient books came into view. Countless scraps abandoned by the sect lay quietly in the dark, exuding a faint glimmer of literature.
Looking at the treasures in front of him, a faint smile appeared on Shen Yan's lips.
The first opportunity to return to the lower class is already in front of you.
